lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਖੀ ਘੜੀ ਨ ਦੇਖਣ ਦੇਈ ਅਪਨਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aukhee ghaRee na dekhan deee apanaa birad samaale ||
lines.translation: He does not let His devotees see the difficult times; this is His innate nature.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਉ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: haath dei raakhai apane kau saas saas pratipaale ||1||
lines.translation: Giving His hand, He protects His devotee; with each and every breath, He cherishes him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਮੇਰਾ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh siu laag rahio meraa cheet ||
lines.translation: My consciousness remains attached to God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aad a(n)t prabh sadaa sahaaee dha(n)n hamaaraa meet || rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the beginning, and in the end, God is always my helper and companion; blessed is my friend. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਭਏ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੇ ਅਚਰਜ ਦੇਖਿ ਬਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bilaas bhae saahib ke acharaj dekh badaaee ||
lines.translation: My mind is delighted, gazing upon the marvellous, glorious greatness of the Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਆਨਦ ਕਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: har simar simar aanad kar naanak prabh pooran paij rakhaaee ||2||15||46||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering the Lord in meditation, Nanak is in ecstasy; God, in His perfection, has protected and preserved his honor. ||2||15||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਗਨਹੁ ਅਭਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis kau bisarai praanapat daataa soee ganahu abhaagaa ||
lines.translation: One who forgets the Lord of life, the Great Giver - know that he is most unfortunate.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਗਿਓ ਅਮਿਅ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਪਾਗਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal jaa kaa man raagio ami sarovar paagaa ||1||
lines.translation: One whose mind is in love with the Lord's lotus feet, obtains the pool of ambrosial nectar. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa jan raam naam ra(n)g jaagaa ||
lines.translation: Your humble servant awakes in the Love of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਲਸੁ ਛੀਜਿ ਗਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aalas chheej gaiaa sabh tan te preetam siu man laagaa || rahaau ||
lines.translation: All laziness has departed from his body, and his mind is attached to the Beloved Lord. ||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਨਾਰਾਇਣ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah jah pekhau tah naaraain sagal ghataa mahi taagaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, the Lord is there; He is the string, upon which all hearts are strung.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਉਦਕੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਆਗੇ ਸਭਿ ਅਨੁਰਾਗਾ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: naam udak peevat jan naanak tiaage sabh anuraagaa ||2||16||47||
lines.translation: Drinking in the water of the Naam, servant Nanak has renounced all other loves. ||2||16||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan ke pooran hoe kaam ||
lines.translation: All the affairs of the Lord's humble servant are perfectly resolved.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਲਜਾ ਰਾਖੀ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalee kaal mahaa bikhiaa mahi lajaa raakhee raam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: In the utterly poisonous Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord preserves and protects his honor. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar suaamee prabh apunaa nikat na aavai jaam ||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering God, his Lord and Master in meditation, the Messenger of Death does not approach him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਧਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: mukat baiku(n)th saadh kee sa(n)gat jan paaio har kaa dhaam ||1||
lines.translation: Liberation and heaven are found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; his humble servant finds the home of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਥਾਤੀ ਕੋਟਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਿਸ੍ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal har jan kee thaatee kot sookh bisraam ||
lines.translation: The Lord's lotus feet are the treasure of His humble servant; in them, he finds millions of pleasures and comforts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਦਮੋਦਰ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਦਿਨ ਰੈਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੮॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d damodar simarau din rain naanak sad kurabaan ||2||17||48||
lines.translation: He remembers the Lord God in meditation, day and night; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||2||17||48||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa(n)gau raam te ik daan ||
lines.translation: I beg for one gift only from the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਸਿਮਰਉ ਤੁਮਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal manorath pooran hovahi simarau tumaraa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: May all my desires be fulfilled, meditating on, and remembering Your Name, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਾਸਹਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan tumhaare hiradai vaasahi sa(n)tan kaa sa(n)g paavau ||
lines.translation: May Your feet abide within my heart, and may I find the Society of the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪੈ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sog agan mahi man na viaapai aath pahar gun gaavau ||1||
lines.translation: May my mind not be afflicted by the fire of sorrow; may I sing Your Glorious Praises, twenty-four hours a day. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਵਸਤਿ ਬਿਵਸਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਮਧੵੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਪਣ ॥
lines.transliteration: svasat bivasathaa har kee sevaa madhy(n)t prabh jaapan ||
lines.translation: May I serve the Lord in my childhood and youth, and meditate on God in my middle and old age.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਗਾ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮ ਨ ਛਾਪਣ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੯॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ra(n)g lagaa paramesar baahuR janam na chhaapan ||2||18||49||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who is imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord, is not reincarnated again to die. ||2||18||49||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਂਗਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: maa(n)gau raam te sabh thok ||
lines.translation: I beg only from the Lord for all things.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੁਖ ਕਉ ਜਾਚਤ ਸ੍ਰਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਮੋਖ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanukh kau jaachat sram paaeeai prabh kai simaran mokh ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I would hesitate to beg from other people. Remembering God in meditation, liberation is obtained. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਘੋਖੇ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਘੋਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghokhe mun jan si(n)mrit puraanaa(n) bed pukaarahi ghokh ||
lines.translation: I have studied with the silent sages, and carefully read the Simritees, the Puraanas and the Vedas; they all proclaim that,

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਦੋਵੈ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਲੋਕ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa si(n)dh sev sach paaeeai dovai suhele lok ||1||
lines.translation: by serving the Lord, the ocean of mercy, Truth is obtained, and both this world and the next are embellished. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨ ਅਚਾਰ ਬਿਉਹਾਰ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਫੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: aan achaar biuhaar hai jete bin har simaran phok ||
lines.translation: All other rituals and customs are useless, without remembering the Lord in meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੋਕ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੫੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak janam maran bhai kaate mil saadhoo binase sok ||2||19||50||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the fear of birth and death has been removed; meeting the Holy Saint, sorrow is dispelled. ||2||19||50||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਬੁਝੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa bujhai har kai naam ||
lines.translation: Desire is quenched, through the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa sa(n)tokh hovai gur bachanee prabh siu laagai pooran dhiaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Great peace and contentment come through the Guru's Word, and one's meditation is perfectly focused upon God. ||1||Pause||
